div.head: Af 40.2
div.ab: Gif mon on lencten halig ryht on folce butan leafe alecge, gebete mid hundtwelftigum scll'.
Gif mon in lenctenne halig ryht in folce butan leafe alecgge, gebete mid CXX scill.
Si quis in quadragesima sanctum uelum in populo sine recto deponat, emendet C uiginti sol.
Gif mon in lenctenne halig ryht in folce butan leafe alecgge, gebete mid CXX scill.
If someone in the folk sets aside holy law without dispensation during Lent, let him compensate with 120 shillings
If anyone, without permission, publicly disregards the laws of the Church during Lent, he shall pay 120 shillings compensation.
Wenn jemand zu Fasten Kirchenrecht öffentlich ohne Dispens bei Seite setzt, büsse er mit 120 Schill.
If someone in Lent publicly sets aside church law without dispensation, let him pay 120 shillings.
